record.question: All are true about delayed umbilical cord clamping in newborn, EXCEPT:
options: Not earlier than 1 minute after birth
Decreases the risk of anemia in infant
Increases iron reserves upto 6 months after birth
May increase the risk of PPH in some mothers
record.explanation: Delayed cord clamping benefits include waiting at least 1 minute, reduced anaemia and improved iron stores; it is not established to increase postpartum haemorrhage risk.
